sections.title: The Cerdà grid
sections.intro: Ildefons Cerdà's 1859 extension plan laid a regular grid over the plain beyond the old city.

slides.title: Streets that follow the grid
slides.body: Carrer d'Aragó and Passeig de Gràcia both run along the grid axes.

slides.title: The street that does not
slides.body: Avinguda Diagonal cuts across the grid, as the plan intended. Among 1,235 named street segments in the study window, it is the clearest break.
